heard_hope.speaker: Sarah
heard_hope.text: Hope I can say at the pickup line. You still owe the nursery a real look, not only a sentence.

heard_service.speaker: Sarah
heard_service.text: You named the nursery. I will believe it when the side door opens without a shoulder.

heard_forgive.speaker: Sarah
heard_forgive.text: Forgiveness is a long word for a twenty-minute Friday. I stayed. The kids colored on the bulletin.

invite_hope.speaker: Sarah
invite_hope.text: You invited me, then preached hope. I will take the coloring pages. I am not joining a committee.

invite_service.speaker: Sarah
invite_service.text: A work list. That I understand. Sunday is still a maybe.

invite_forgive.speaker: Sarah
invite_forgive.text: I do not have a feud to forgive. I have a sticky door and a Tuesday that is already full.
